why: B says the project's IsClosedBranched Θ and IsCompactBranched Θ are IsClosed (π '' suppB Θ) and IsCompact (π '' suppB Θ). Both hold by Iff.rfl, since orbitSupp Θ is π '' supp Θ and supp is suppB, so the definitions agree exactly. A is only the witness isCompactBranched_indicator (the indicator of a point of ℝⁿ is compact). B_to_A goes through B's iff and then shows suppB 1_{p} = {p} and that the image of a point is compact. A_to_B proves B outright (it is definitional). No universe parameters.
overlap: B_to_A: 390 shared project theorems. All of them are the proof fields of the trivial ep-groupoid of ℝⁿ (EpGroupoid.trivial._proof_*, rnPolyfold / rnChart, sc-calculus and sub-M-polyfold glue), reached through the statement's type. No Chapter 9 lemma (supp_indicator_singleton etc.) is reused.
